info.title: GrillMe Control Plane API
info.description: Control-plane contracts for desktop bearer-token clients and same-origin browser cookie clients. Desktop session grants return opaque access and refresh tokens; browser session endpoints return account data and manage an HttpOnly secure cookie without returning tokens.

tags.name: Desktop session
tags.description: Native desktop OAuth exchange and token lifecycle.

tags.name: Browser session
tags.description: Same-origin browser authorization and HttpOnly cookie lifecycle.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code and PKCE verifier for a desktop token grant

200.description: Desktop session grant containing opaque client-managed tokens

post.summary: Rotate a desktop refresh token and return a new token grant
Revoke a desktop refresh token

get.description: Redirects to the identity provider and establishes server-side authorization state. No bearer token is returned to the browser.

302.description: Redirect to the configured identity provider

post.summary: Restore an account session from the browser cookie
post.description: Returns account session data only. Browser session tokens remain in an HttpOnly cookie.

200.description: Restored browser account session without token fields

post.summary: Complete browser authorization and establish the session cookie
post.description: Returns account session data and sets an HttpOnly cookie; access and refresh tokens are never present in the JSON response.

post.summary: Refresh and rotate the browser session cookie
post.description: Rotates the HttpOnly cookie and returns account session data without exposing tokens.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque short-lived desktop access token returned only by desktop session grant endpoints.

cookieAuth.name: __Host-grillme_session
cookieAuth.description: Opaque Secure HttpOnly same-origin browser session cookie. The cookie value is never returned in JSON.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is missing, expired, or revoked

Forbidden.description: The authenticated user is not entitled to this capability

Gone.description: The requested session or lease has expired

TooManyRequests.description: A quota, attempt, or spend ceiling was reached

ServiceUnavailable.description: The control-plane capability is temporarily unavailable

LabUnavailable.description: The lab provider is temporarily unavailable

AwsLabUnavailable.description: The restricted AWS lab provider is temporarily unavailable

refreshToken.description: Opaque desktop refresh token for secure OS storage.

BrowserSessionResponse.description: Browser account data only; deliberately excludes accessToken and refreshToken fields.

connectionTicket.description: Opaque short-lived connection ticket; not an AWS credential.

summary.description: Sanitized learner report; secrets and credentials are rejected.
